items.title: Abel-Jacobi and symmetric-power factorisation
items.summary:
Abel-Jacobi and symmetric-power factorisation. Milne's argument over the symmetric power
is PROVED (Albanese/AlbaneseFromData.lean, axiom-clean); the residue is the OBJECT
Sym^g C, equivalently the single instance HasColimit (permDiagram C g)
(SymPowColimit.hasColimit_permDiagram_iff -- an equivalence, so the reduction is lossless).

Route: explicit Scheme.GlueData from affine charts. The bill is four items. As of run 0069 r7:
3 SUPPLIED, 1 OPEN. The authoritative count lives in StableAffineCoverGroup.lean's header --
this row is a pointer to it, not a second source of truth (a review found the two disagreeing).
Read the change from r6's "2 supplied, 1 partial, 1 open" as item 3 completing, NOT as
vindicating an older row that said "3 of 4" for a different and wrong reason.

 1. DONE. G-stable affine open neighbourhoods for a finite group acting by automorphisms
    (Albanese/StableAffineCoverGroup.lean) plus exists_stable_affineOpen_perm{,_over}.
 2. DONE. The Aut-valued S_n-action MonObj.permAutHom (Albanese/GrpObjFoldSum.lean).
 3. DONE (r7). Algebra level: TensorPowerCoproduct.lean (existsUnique_coprodLift,
    coprodLift_permAlgHom, permAlgHom_comp_singleAlgHom). The Cofan/IsColimit packaging that
    was the missing half: TensorPowerCofan.lean (tensorPowerCofanIsColimit, plus
    tensorPowerFanIsLimit for the (Under k)-op variance and tensorPowerCofan_inj_permAlgHom
    for equivariance on the coprojections). The one trap, measured: CommRingCat.toAlgHom is
    typed over the algebra instance REBUILT from the structure morphism, not the ambient one,
    so it does not unify -- algHomOfMkUnderHom is the version over the ambient instance
    (proof: Under.w plus a congrArg; both round trips rfl).
 4. OPEN, and genuinely geometric: the overlap/cocycle agreement of the chart quotients, and
    OrbitsInAffineOpen FOR THE CURVE -- where quasi-projectivity enters and mathlib has no
    such vocabulary at this pin. THIS IS THE WHOLE REMAINING RESIDUE of the affine-and-glue
    route.

BEYOND THE BILL, r7 also named the affine carrier, which three files had recorded as expected
but unproved:
 * SymPowAffineCarrier.tensorPowerOpIsoPiObj -- the n-fold product in (Under k)-op that
   permDiagram is BUILT ON is op (mkUnder k (tensor power)), i.e. (Spec_k A)^n = Spec_k A^{⊗n},
   with permAut_eq_op_permAlgHom matching the actions (and it carries e-inverse; the kernel
   forced that -- the wrong variance leaves a goal true only at an involution).
 * SymPowAffineQuotient.colimitPermDiagramIsoFixed -- the QUOTIENT:
   colimit (permDiagram (op (mkUnder k A)) n) is iso to op (fixedUnder ... (tensor power)),
   Milne III.3 Prop 3.1's affine half with the object identified. SymPowColimit §5's bold
   caveat "the carrier is not named in Lean" is discharged and deleted.

TWO HONEST LIMITS ON THAT, both measured this round rather than assumed:
 (a) The accompanying HasColimit (permDiagram (op (mkUnder k A)) n) is NOT a new fact --
     infer_instance discharges it from cocompleteness. Only the ISO is new. An earlier draft
     offered an existence restatement as the payoff; it was vacuous, because naming an object
     needs a statement that MENTIONS the object.
 (b) The SECOND bridge of Milne's affine half -- that (Under k)-op IS the category of affine
     k-schemes, via Over.opEquivOpUnder and AffineScheme.equivCommRingCat -- is still unbuilt.
     So all of the above is k-ALGEBRA language, not Spec-language, and symPowData_affineAlgebra
     was not rewritten to consume the named carrier.

CONSUMPTION, checked by grep not asserted: SymPowAffineCarrier.lean consumes the Cofan layer in
proof bodies (:138, :150, :184) and SymPowAffineQuotient consumes that -- the first consumer of
anything this lane has built in five rounds. But AlbaneseUP / AlbaneseFromData /
AlbaneseFromColimit mention NONE of these names (zero hits). This is a consumer inside the
affine story, not integration with the capstone; item 4 is what stands between.

AlbaneseUP.lean's six sorries are UNCHANGED and albanese_universal_property still reports
sorryAx. All six are stated against the sorry-BODIED SymmetricPower, so they remain
undischargeable as stated rather than merely unproved.

items.title: Albanese universal property
items.summary:
Albanese universal property. THE ARGUMENT IS PROVED (run 0069); what remains is one precisely-named typeclass instance, not "one missing object" in general.

MILNE III.6.1 IS PROVED, both connector directions, over the symmetric power taken as an interface rather than a sorry -- Albanese/AlbaneseFromData.lean and Albanese/AlbaneseJacobian.lean, sorry-free. Forward (symAVMap_eq_of_albanese_eq) needs psi to be a HOMOMORPHISM: pushing psi through the g-fold sum is map_prod (IsMonHom.monoidHom), exactly where Milne's step 5 uses homomorphy. Backward (albanese_eq_of_symAVMap_eq) needs neither that nor the quotient universal property -- it is restriction along Q |-> (Q,P0,...,P0) plus the collapse basePointShift_comp_powSum.

THE RESIDUE IS NOW PRECISE (Albanese/AlbaneseFromColimit.lean, corrected 2026-07-28 commit af3d7b6a2 after an earlier draft got the binder wrong): exists_unique_albanese_of_scheme_colimits takes no SymPowData argument and no hproj argument -- the symmetric power is symPowOfColimit C g and its symmetry is colimit.w, free at every n. The single remaining typeclass hypothesis is HasColimit (permDiagram C g): ONE diagram, for THIS curve and THIS g, in Over (Spec kbar). It is NOT HasColimitsOfShape (SingleObj (Equiv.Perm (Fin g))) Scheme -- that shape-quantified form is strictly stronger, is not what hasColimit_permDiagram_iff covers, and is believed FALSE at this pin (schemes have no coequalizers in general); a theorem carrying it would be vacuous. See AJC.albanese.symmetric for the state of discharging that instance. UPDATED run 0069 r7: this row previously said "TWO residues now, in order: the Cofan/IsColimit packaging in (Under k)-op ... and then the gluing". The FIRST is closed (Albanese/TensorPowerCofan.lean), so there is ONE residue left and it is the geometric wall: the gluing/cocycle compatibility of the chart quotients plus OrbitsInAffineOpen for the curve, where quasi-projectivity enters and mathlib has no such vocabulary at this pin. r7 also named the affine carrier at both ends (SymPowAffineCarrier.tensorPowerOpIsoPiObj for the input, SymPowAffineQuotient.colimitPermDiagramIsoFixed for the quotient = Milne III.3 Prop 3.1's affine half with the object identified), which discharged SymPowColimit §5's "carrier is not named in Lean" caveat. NONE of that shortens the curve residue: the affine chain is stated over mkUnder k A in (Under k)-op, and C is a proper curve in Over (Spec kbar). Do not read "3 of 4 items supplied" as "3/4 of the way to Sym^g C" -- item 4 is the whole of the geometry.

THE MEASUREMENT, which attributes the residual sorry rather than asserting whose it is:
    #print axioms exists_unique_albanese_of_scheme_colimits -> [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]  AXIOM-CLEAN
    #print axioms Pic0.albanese_universal_property_of_symPowData    -> [propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
Same statement; the sole difference is whether the target group object is Pic0.jacobianScheme C or an arbitrary abelian variety. So the entire sorryAx residue of the Pic0 form is the PICARD REPRESENTABILITY SEAM upstream of this leg, and none of it is Milne's argument.

DISCHARGED UNCONDITIONALLY (Albanese/AVSelfProduct.lean, on the project's four-instance abelian-variety package): commutativity of an abelian variety (Milne I.1.4) and pointed rigidity (Milne I.1.2). The obstruction had been instance KEYING through the monoidal notation, not missing mathematics.

REMAINING INPUTS: (1) HasColimit (permDiagram C g) -- see AJC.albanese.symmetric; (2) Milne III.5.1(a) birationality as a SECTION of f^(g) over a dense open. The descent around them is closed: extend_to_av (Milne Thm 3.2) is unconditional and axiom-clean, and exists_unique_descent_of_section / hom_ext_of_dense_open package it in elementary terms with no rational map in the statement.

NOT A CLOSED RESULT ABOUT THE JACOBIAN, and the module headers say so in those words. The pinned Pic0.albanese_universal_property still reports sorryAx and its six sorries in AlbaneseUP.lean are UNCHANGED -- they are stated against a sorry-BODIED SymmetricPower and are undischargeable as stated, which the AlbaneseUP.lean header now records along with a pointer to where the mathematics lives.

items.title: Albanese and abelian-variety leg
items.summary:
Albanese and abelian-variety leg. Three of five children done (.ab, .codim1, .rationalmaps);
.symmetric and .universal remain, and BOTH are blocked on the same single object.

STATE AT RUN 0069 r5, measured not estimated:
 * Milne III.6.1 (the Albanese universal property) is PROVED over the symmetric power taken
   as an interface -- Albanese/AlbaneseFromData.lean, sorry-free, both directions.
 * Milne Lemma 3.3 (pure codim-1 indeterminacy into a group variety) is PROVED, and with it
   Thm 3.2's rational-map extension is unconditional. CodimOneExtension.lean and
   RigidityLemma.lean are at ZERO sorries -- any brief or note citing sorries there is
   quoting docstring prose.
 * ALL SIX remaining sorries in the leg are in Albanese/AlbaneseUP.lean, and every one is
   stated against SymmetricPower, a sorry-BODIED definition. They are undischargeable as
   stated, not merely unproved: an equation between morphisms out of a junk term carries no
   information. albanese_universal_property reports sorryAx and must not be called landed.

THE ONE MISSING OBJECT is Sym^g C for the proper curve, equivalently the instance
HasColimit (permDiagram C g) in Over (Spec kbar) -- proved EQUIVALENT to the datum the
Albanese theorems consume (SymPowColimit.hasColimit_permDiagram_iff), so the reduction is
lossless. Over.forget creates colimits, so no over-category bookkeeping is needed: it is a
statement about Scheme.

THE AFFINE HALF IS NOW DONE, with its carrier named and over the base: SymPowTensorAction
.lean (the S_n-action on the n-fold tensor power of a RING -- mathlib had permutation only as
a linear equiv, so Milne's carrier was not even STATEABLE) and SymPowInvariantsUnder.lean
(the invariants ARE the limit in Under k, dually a colimit in (Under k)^op).

WHAT REMAINS IS THE GLUING, and it is now three named inputs rather than an unsized
subproject. One of the three closed this round: StableAffineCoverGroup.lean proves every
point has a G-STABLE affine open neighbourhood for a bare finite group -- the same proof as
Picard/StableAffineCover.lean, whose Galois binder its body never touches. The other two:
(i) cocycle/overlap agreement of the affine chart quotients; (ii) OrbitsInAffineOpen for the
curve, which is where quasi-projectivity enters and mathlib has no quasi-projectivity
vocabulary at this pin.

Availability measured at this pin so nobody re-searches: HasCoproducts Scheme YES,
HasCoequalizers/HasPushouts Scheme NO, Scheme.GlueData YES.

DELTA, run 0069 r7 (nothing above is retracted; the sorry count is UNCHANGED at six).
The affine half of the symmetric-power route closed out. Item 3 of the four-item glue-data
bill is DONE (Albanese/TensorPowerCofan.lean packages the tensor power as the n-ary coproduct
in Under k), so the bill is 3 SUPPLIED / 1 OPEN, and the affine carrier is now NAMED at both
ends: SymPowAffineCarrier.tensorPowerOpIsoPiObj (the n-fold product permDiagram is built on IS
op of the tensor power, actions matched) and SymPowAffineQuotient.colimitPermDiagramIsoFixed
(the colimit IS op of Milne's (A^{⊗n})^{S_n}). SymPowColimit §5's bold caveat "the carrier is
not named in Lean" is discharged and deleted. 12 new declarations, all kernel-checked EXIT=0
and axiom-clean with controls firing sorryAx.

WHAT THIS DOES NOT DO, stated because "3 of 4" invites the wrong inference: item 4 -- the
overlap/cocycle agreement of the chart quotients and OrbitsInAffineOpen FOR THE CURVE -- is
the whole of the geometry, and it is untouched. The affine chain is stated over mkUnder k A in
(Under k)-op; C is a proper curve in Over (Spec kbar). Nothing in AlbaneseUP /
AlbaneseFromData / AlbaneseFromColimit mentions any of the new names (checked, zero hits), so
this is integration WITHIN the affine story, not with the capstone. Also unbuilt: the second
bridge of Milne's affine half, that (Under k)-op IS affine k-schemes -- so all of it is
k-algebra language rather than Spec-language.

TWO SELF-CORRECTIONS worth more than the lemmas, both caught before or by the kernel:
 (a) I first offered an EXISTENCE restatement as the carrier-naming payoff. Vacuous: it was
     literally symPowData_affineAlgebra instantiated, and which proof supplied the instance is
     invisible in it. Then I measured the instance -- infer_instance discharges the HasColimit
     from cocompleteness alone -- so that theorem adds nothing provable either. Naming an
     object requires a statement that MENTIONS the object.
 (b) My first header said the "carrier is not named" caveat was "now false" on the strength of
     naming the INPUT (the object the action acts on) when the caveat is about the QUOTIENT.
     Input vs output. Repaired, then the quotient actually proved, then the caveat deleted.

items.title: Exactness of the tilde functor (Stacks 01HV)
items.summary:
Exactness of the tilde functor (Stacks 01HV), blueprint lem:tilde_preserves_kernels. DONE, sorry-free, kernel-verified (run 0068). Cohomology/TildeExactness.lean is now entirely sorry-free -- this was that file's long-open named target, with a header section literally titled "Why tildePreservesFiniteLimits itself is NOT closed here".

LANDED: tilde_preservesMonomorphisms, tildePreservesFiniteLimits, tilde_preservesHomology, plus the supporting sectMap / sectMap_eq / tilde_injective_app_basicOpen.

ROUTE -- basic opens, not stalks. Basic opens are a basis of Spec R, and mathlib ALREADY exhibits Gamma(M~, D(r)) as a localisation of M at the powers of r (tilde.toOpen carries an IsLocalizedModule.Away instance). So the section map of ~f over D(r) IS IsLocalizedModule.map of f (by IsLocalizedModule.ext against the naturality square tilde.toOpen_map_app), injective by IsLocalizedModule.map_injective since localisation is flat. Basis injectivity gives stalkwise injectivity hence mono; right exactness is free (left adjoint); right exact + mono-preserving => left exact.

WHY IT IS WORTH RECORDING AS A LESSON, not just a result. The file's own header prescribed a DIFFERENT route and estimated 100-150 LOC for it: R-linearity of the Ab STALK map, then a jointly-reflecting stalk family through JointlyReflectIsomorphisms.jointlyReflectsLimit, with a long warning that the ModuleCat-valued stalk path is dead because mathlib keeps toStalk_l / stalkIso_l / stalkToLocalization_l private. NONE of that is needed on the basic-open route: the injectivity check happens BEFORE any stalk is formed, so no stalk colimit and no jointly-reflecting step enters, and the R-linearity that matters is on SECTIONS where Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul supplies it in one line. A carefully-written plan in a docstring is evidence about ONE route, not about the difficulty of the statement. The header has been corrected in place; the section-1 stalk material is retained as the sharpest per-point statement.

items.title: Package the final Jacobian witness
items.summary:
Construct picardJacobianWitness from Picard representability, the Pic0 abelian-variety structure, dimension g, and the Albanese universal property; discharge the protected Jacobian interface.

The structure is built and wired: the witness IS Scheme.Pic0SchemeEt, the identity component of the scheme representing the etale-sheafified relative Picard functor. What remains is mathematics, not assembly, so THIS ITEM STAYS OPEN WITH ITS ONLY CHILD DONE -- that status mismatch is deliberate and must not be "fixed". The parent is the assembly step, not a container, and it rests on five open obligations.

THE FIVE OBLIGATIONS, restated after the owner decision of 2026-07-28 (protection I-0491, branch (2) ETALE-SHEAFIFY): none of them is a false statement any more, which is the substance of that change rather than the count.

- Scheme.fgaPicardRepresentability -- representability of the etale-sheafified functor over an ARBITRARY field, with no rational-point binder. The project's central open obligation, expected to stay open.
- Scheme.Pic0Et.geometricallyReduced -- Cartier in characteristic zero, a genuine statement in characteristic p.
- Scheme.Pic0Et.universallyClosed -- Kleiman section 5.
- smoothOfRelativeDimension_genus_pic0Et and isAlbanese_pic0Et -- the two leaves stated at the headline.

Note the middle two rather than Pic0Et.smooth / Pic0Et.proper: those are ASSEMBLIES over them, not obligations of their own, so citing them as the open statements is a stale reading. An earlier version of this summary did exactly that, and also listed a "leaf A (rational point)"; hasRationalPoint_of_curve was FALSE as stated and has been deleted, never proved (I-0491 clause 1).

DISTANCES TO THE LANDED TREE, measured with scripts/axiom-frontier.lean rather than asserted, and unequal:

- LEAF C (Albanese) is the closest. isAlbanese_pic0_of_isAlgClosed is a THEOREM: over an algebraically closed field, in positive genus, and given the basepoint condition, the universal property is Albanese.Pic0.albanese_universal_property applied with no transport. So leaf C adds exactly three things -- arbitrary base field (cluster G descent), genus zero (Mumford rigidity), and the basepoint condition P o iota_P = eta. The third is easily overlooked: it is a conjunct of IsAlbanese that the landed theorem never states, and it cannot be discharged before Pic0.abelJacobi is constructed, since it is a statement about that morphism.
- LEAF B (dimension refinement) has its landed half at the headline too, and it is NOT the dimension count. finrank_tangentSpace_pic0_eq_genus proves dim T_e Pic0 = genus C via Pic0.finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_finrank_hModuleOne with no transport, since genus C is definitionally dim_k H^1(C,O_C). So leaf B owes a TRANSLATION between two invariants of smoothness, plus the transport of that landed chain from Pic0Scheme to Pic0SchemeEt (the honest extra cost of the etale formulation). On the translation: mathlib's SmoothOfRelativeDimension mentions no tangent space, but it is not bridge-free -- Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.iff_of_isStandardSmooth characterises relative dimension n as Module.rank S Omega[S/R] = n, an iff -- so the work is the duality over a field between rank Omega and the tangent-space dimension, plus the affine-local-to-scheme-level passage over a cover of Pic0. An earlier summary called this missing mathematics with no bridge; that was retracted (memory I-0446).

Pic0Et.geometricallyReduced and Pic0Et.universallyClosed belong to no current task and are the nearest unowned work under the headline.

items.summary:
The headline rests on the infrastructure it claims, and every number here is measured rather than asserted. picardJacobianWitness is built from Scheme.Pic0Scheme, so 98 of the project's modules are reachable from Jacobian.lean rather than the 8 of the Genus-only import; the 98th arrived when leaf C was stated against the landed Albanese universal property, which put the Albanese cone under the headline for the first time.

EVERY MODULE ON DISK IS ROOTED at AlgebraicJacobian.lean -- 187 of 187 as of 2026-07-28, no exceptions. ONE CONVENTION FOR THE DENOMINATOR, since the two figures in this node count differently and Ground flagged it: 187 is the number of .lean files UNDER AlgebraicJacobian/, excluding the root aggregator AlgebraicJacobian.lean itself, which is the seed rather than a member. Both '187 of 187 rooted' and '98 of 187 reachable from the headline' use that same 187, so they are comparable; the tree contains 188 files if you count the root. which matters because an unrooted module compiles green and is invisible BOTH to the root build and to the axiom probe: #print axioms on its declarations cannot even be written against the root import. The standing check is in the probe header and in I-0388. A module not yet committed to the ledger must NOT be rooted (a clean checkout would fail); that grace period ends at the commit.

THE OBLIGATION COUNT IS FIVE, over a general base field AND over an algebraically closed one. The count does not drop when leaf A is discharged; only the KIND of the obligations changes. The five: instHasPicScheme, Pic0.smooth and Pic0.proper (sorry-bodied upstream), and leaves B and C stated at the headline -- with leaf A a sixth over a general field, where it is the FALSE one. Each leaf's distance to the landed tree is COMPILER-CHECKED rather than described, by a companion theorem stated at the headline:

  leaf A (rational point) -- FALSE over a general k, so it must be REPLACED, not proved. Over an algebraically closed field it is a THEOREM: hasRationalPoint_of_curve_of_isAlgClosed is axiom-clean via Albanese.hasRationalPoint_of_isAlgClosed, and picardJacobianWitnessOfIsAlgClosed assembles the witness with it supplied rather than assumed. This bounds I-0372's decision without choosing a branch: what is undecided is what the project claims over an ARBITRARY base field.
  instHasPicScheme (representability) -- the obligation that is easy to miscount. Scheme.Pic0Scheme carries [HasPicScheme C] and this sorry-bodied instance is its sole producer. Over a general field the gate is reached THROUGH leaf A, so counting it separately looks like double-counting; discharging leaf A makes it FIRE rather than removing it, so over k-bar it stands free.
  leaf B -- owes Pic0.smooth plus the passage from a tangent-space dimension to Mathlib's presentation-based SmoothOfRelativeDimension; the dimension count itself is landed (finrank_tangentSpace_pic0_eq_genus proves dim T_e Pic0 = genus C with no transport).
  leaf C -- one basepoint condition plus two generalizations away (isAlbanese_pic0_of_isAlgClosed proves the algebraically closed positive-genus case).

WHY THE KIND OF OBLIGATION MATTERS AND CANNOT BE READ OFF THE PROBE: over k-bar all five are unproved TRUE statements; leaf A over a general field is FALSE, so the general witness rests on an inconsistent hypothesis and its consequences are vacuously true. Both states report exactly the same sorryAx, so the distinction has to be exhibited by a discharge rather than measured. That is why the alg-closed witness is a separate definition.

RETRACTED (2026-07-28, caught by Ground and reproduced independently): an earlier revision of this summary said the alg-closed witness rests on FOUR obligations, and a later revision retracted that in a trailing paragraph while leaving the FOUR standing in its own opening -- so the node contradicted itself for one round. Both are now corrected to five. Trap (a) landed on the very declaration whose docstring warns about trap (c). MEASURED as probe section 0b: naming Pic0Scheme with leaf A discharged and nothing else in the term still reports sorryAx, against a gate-assumed control that is clean. The claim that survives is unchanged and was always the valuable one: over k-bar all five remaining obligations are TRUE statements.

AND NOTE WHAT THIS DOES NOT MOVE: picardJacobianWitnessOfIsAlgClosed has ZERO Lean consumers. The five protected declarations still route Jacobian -> jacobianWitness -> nonempty_jacobianWitness -> picardJacobianWitness -> hasRationalPoint_of_curve, i.e. through the false leaf. Nothing about the protected surface has changed.

REPRODUCIBLE and independently re-measured 2026-07-28 THROUGH THE ROOT PATH with lake build AlgebraicJacobian green at 8746 jobs: scripts/axiom-frontier.lean, 126 declarations, 84 clean and 42 carrying sorryAx (125/84/41 before section 0c added the branch-(1) assembly; 113/72/41 before section 6f added ajc-rr's unconditional-chi lines, all clean; 107/70/37 before that). Note how the last two additions moved the sorryAx count in OPPOSITE directions, for the right reasons: section 6f added declarations and left it at 41, because an all-clean lane adds nothing to the frontier and a clean line is therefore not by itself headline progress; section 0c added one and moved it to 42, because the branch-(1) assembly leaks on the five obligations behind it. Neither movement changed the mathematics -- the frontier is the same five obligations throughout. 26 sorry carriers over 11 modules, matching the enumeration published in the probe's section 2 exactly -- of those 26, exactly TWO are instances (instHasPicScheme, pullback_preservesFiniteLimits) and therefore the only two reachable without being named; 98 modules reachable from the headline of 187 on disk, zero unrooted. Count by output ENTRY, not by line -- Lean wraps long axiom lists, and the naive per-line filter misclassifies exactly the declarations whose lists are longest. Two earlier revisions of this summary published 24 rather than 26; the build says 26 and the probe carries the regenerating command so the number is checkable rather than asserted.

items.title: Resolve remaining pin contracts
items.summary:
CLASSIFIED, and the load-bearing finding is that NONE of the 33 rides on a completeness claim. Measured 2026-07-28 by re-running the sync and reading each warned node's environment: not one of the 33 nodes carries \leanok, \mathlibok or any other assertion that its Lean is written and checked. So the warnings are unresolved FORWARD CONTRACTS and renames, never a false "this is formalized" claim. That is the question the item was really asking, and it is now answered by measurement rather than by inspection of a sample.

REGENERATE THE LIST (the numbers move as modules land, so do not quote this one without re-running):

  horizon graph -p Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge sync \
    --blueprint blueprint/src/web.tex --lean AlgebraicJacobian 2>&1 | grep warning:

Current: 33 warnings, all of the form '\lean{N} not found in Lean sources'. Sync itself is otherwise clean -- 1935 blueprint nodes, 4630 Lean nodes, 6719 generated edges, 8 marked stale.

THE THREE CLASSES, by cause rather than by chapter:

  (a) DELIBERATE FORWARD CONTRACTS, 7 of 33, pinned under the AlgebraicGeometry.TODO namespace, which exists precisely to make an unwritten target visible: TODO.rel_pic_etale_sheaf_unit_canonical, TODO.quotReductionToPiStarW, TODO.quotBoundedness, TODO.quotAlphaInjective, TODO.quotValuativeCriterion, TODO.stage6_regular_stalk_assembly, TODO.weilDivisorObstruction. Four of the seven are Quot-endgame nodes, i.e. off-path mathematics retained deliberately (see the route note in Picard_QuotScheme.tex); leaving them unresolved is correct and they should NOT be repinned to anything.

  (a2) SCANNER FALSE NEGATIVES, 2 of 33, and these are NOT the blueprint's fault:
lem:toSheaf_preservesFiniteColimits and lem:to_sheaf_preserves_epi pin
AlgebraicGeometry.toSheaf_preservesFiniteColimits and .toSheaf_preservesEpimorphisms, which DO exist
(Cohomology/AffineSerreVanishing.lean:121 and :153) and ARE proved ([propext, Classical.choice,
Quot.sound] through the root path). The graph's Lean indexer does not accept a declaration whose NAME
carries an explicit universe-binder suffix -- `theorem toSheaf_preservesFiniteColimits.{v', u', w'}` --
so it never indexes them; `graph get decl:...` returns 'no node matching'. Exactly four declarations
tree-wide use that syntax, and these are the two with pins. Both nodes now carry \leanok on statement
and proof (correct: the Lean is written and checked, only the scanner disagreed), so these two
warnings will PERSIST until the tooling is fixed and should not be chased in this project. Filed
upstream as I-0452.

  (b) RENAMED OR RESHAPED TARGETS, where the mathematics landed under a different name. Resolvable by name, one node at a time, and this is the only class where work remains. Confirmed candidates found by horizon search: lem:presentation_restrict_basicOpen -> presentationModulesRestrictBasicOpen, lem:qcoh_localized_sections -> qcoh_iso_tilde_sections_hom/_inv, lem:qcoh_global_generation -> qcoh_iso_tilde_sections_of_genSections, lem:tilde_preserves_kernels -> tildePreservesFiniteLimits_of_toPresheaf or tilde_preservesFiniteLimits_of_preservesKernels, the two MvPolynomial height nodes -> MvPolynomial.height_eq_natCard_of_isMaximal. Each repin must be checked against the SIGNATURE, not just the name: a node whose statement no longer matches its renamed target is a worse defect than an unresolved pin, because it would then be eligible for \leanok.

  (c) GENUINELY UNWRITTEN, no candidate in any project or in mathlib: the four pushforwardPullbackBaseChange naturality/hom/natIso nodes (only pushforwardPullbackBaseChangeIso exists, which is a different statement), tilde_restrict_basicOpen, isQuasicoherent_restrict_basicOpen, qcoh_kernel_qcoh, the section-graded ring/module and Hilbert-polynomial-of-section-module nodes, the three graded-instance defs, gr_modules_glueHom, and the two standard-smooth Krull-dimension nodes. These are the blueprint running ahead of the Lean, which is the intended direction; they are not defects.

WHY THIS IS NOT MERELY BOOKKEEPING: an unresolved pin is the fifth way a clean axiom line can mislead, in a mirror form. The probe cannot see a node whose Lean does not exist, so a chapter can look complete in the DAG while its pins resolve to nothing. The check that this is not happening is the \leanok audit above, and it should be re-run whenever the warning count changes rather than only when it grows.

THE ROUTE-CLAIM PASS, which is what this item was mainly waiting on. Nine passages across four chapters described the Quot/quotient endgame in the present tense as the way the Picard scheme gets built, while the FGA chapter's own route comparison already said it is not the path being formalised.   Picard_FlatteningStratification.tex -- the chapter had framed its whole content as a step INSIDE the Quot construction. Order reversed: it states the flattening stratification and its universal property as a theorem of commutative algebra and scheme theory independent of any moduli construction, then records that Nitsure's Quot construction consumes it. That is the honest shape -- the mathematics does not depend on who uses it.
  Picard_LineBundleCoherence.tex -- an "on-path half of the A.2.c Quot-scheme embedding" strategy note becomes a SCOPE note stating what the chapter proves, with the load-bearing caveat (the 0B8M converse spreading-out is not crossed) kept verbatim; two body phrases replace "in the sense the Quot construction consumes" and a "flagged for the plan agent" aside with the mathematical reason.
  Picard_SectionGradedRing.tex -- "the Hilbert-polynomial ROUTE of" becomes "development".

Deliberately unchanged: passages describing the INTERNAL architecture of the Quot construction (that is what those chapters are about, and they claim nothing about the Picard route), and the Grassmannian chapters, swept and found clean.

ALSO THIS PASS, in the FGA chapter itself: rem:representability_is_conditional. Four nodes there carry a statement \leanok and are the ones a reader is most likely to read as "the Picard scheme exists in this development" -- thm:fga_pic_representability, def:pic_scheme, def:inst_pic_sharp_representable, thm:pic_is_group_scheme. items.title: Replace the remaining bare import Mathlib (66 of 172 modules) by precise imports
items.summary:
The dominant build cost, and the method is now settled. 86 of 164 modules opened with a bare 'import Mathlib'; measured on Cohomology/SheafCompose.lean (49 lines), 16.6 s and about 7 GB with the umbrella versus 3.5 s and 1.97 GB with four precise imports. Converted modules were observed at 2.5-3.4 GB against 6.8-7.0 GB before, which is the second lever: at 7 GB per process a 62 GB host sustains about 8 concurrent jobs instead of 16, and the from-scratch build's 33-minute serial tail ran with exactly one job.

ORDERING RULE, learned the expensive way. Bottom-up is right for probe CORRECTNESS -- a module's minimal imports cannot be computed until everything beneath it is clean -- but wrong for NET PROGRESS whenever the module has a cone of import-less dependents above it. Narrowing StructureSheafModuleK/Presheaf.lean stripped the library from nine modules in the StructureSheafModuleK -> Genus -> Jacobian chain. Over wave 2, converting 8 modules forced 25 back onto the umbrella and the count went 39 back up to 64. Give a module's import-less dependents their own precise imports FIRST, top-down within the cone, then narrow the parent.

THE REAL WORK ITEM is the 54 modules that declare no Mathlib import at all and inherit the library transitively. They are invisible to the minimal-import probe because nothing in their own text says what they need, and every one that gets its own imports permanently removes a class of breakage. Elaborating all 54 in parallel with 'lake env lean' (read-only against .lake/build, safe alongside a running build) resolves the whole exposure in minutes; a full build finds only one victim per round because lake stops at the first failure in a chain. Of the 54, exactly 24 needed Mathlib -- the other 30 were loading 1.79 GB of oleans for nothing and are pure wins.

STATE: 64 of 164 bare, down from 86. GrassmannianQuot.lean resists narrowing outright (times out at isDefEq :924 and whnf :1217 at default heartbeats WITH precise imports, builds fine with the umbrella) and stays bare deliberately. scripts/deumbrella-wave.sh now repairs its own cascade per wave and refuses to advance until green.

DEFERRED 2026-07-27 (janitor hygiene pass, run 0053) -- status moved active -> pending, and the
campaign is paused, not abandoned. Nothing here is retracted; the ordering rule and the 54-module
finding stay the durable content. Re-measured today: 66 of 172 modules still open with a bare
'import Mathlib' (the total rose from 164 because run 0053 added Picard/RigidPushforward* modules).
Last wave was 3fbc2cace ('wave 2 lands green -- 8 modules narrowed, 25 restored, net 86 to 64
bare'), under run 0046 / task ajc-optimize, which is queued and not running.

WHY PENDING RATHER THAN ACTIVE. It had no owner, no live run, and its parent AJC.maintenance is
already active with the same milestone, so it was spending one of the workspace's active slots
while the three live runs (ajc-gate, ajc-rr, ajc-truth) all work elsewhere. Set it back to active
when a session actually picks up wave 3 -- and read the ORDERING RULE above before doing so.

items.title: Headline obligation 5: the Albanese universal property of Pic0SchemeEt over an arbitrary field

*** THE r2 COSTING ON THIS ROW WAS WRONG IN BOTH DIRECTIONS AND IS RETRACTED (I-1285, my own item I-1115). Read this before pricing anything here. ***

BOTH FALSE, and they point opposite ways.

(1) THE NAMED LEMMA IS NOT THE ONE THE CHAIN CALLS. isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_smooth (:1237) delegates to isRegularLocalRing_of_isLocalization_atPrime_of_isStandardSmooth_of_perfectField (Albanese/SmoothPrimeRegularity.lean:665) -- sorry-free, ARBITRARY prime, PERFECT field -- and says so in its own docstring. The residue-degree-aware theorem r2 asked a lane to build was already in the tree and already in use.

LANDED as a consequence (50049b5f93, eba86a9947): Albanese/CodimOnePerfectField.lean, rooted, 5 theorems, 0 sorries -- Stacks 00TT at every point, reducedness of a smooth scheme, the codim-1 DVR, Milne Theorem 3.1 and its CodimOneFree phrasing, all over [PerfectField k]. All 11 axiom-clean [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] vs isAlbanese_pic0Et and fgaPicardRepresentability as controls that BOTH fire sorryAx.

ONE ASYMMETRY WORTH INHERITING: reducedness does NOT widen by transcription. isReduced_of_smooth_of_isAlgClosed's chart-ring input IS the closed-point argument. The perfect-field version goes regular local => domain => reduced at each stalk instead, naming no closed point.

(2) THE LIVE LINK IS MILNE 3.3, ONE HOP ABOVE WHERE r2 PUT IT. indeterminacy_pure_codim_one_into_grpScheme binds [IsAlgClosed] on the section VARIABLE line (Milne33.lean:57) -- invisible in the declaration header, visible to #check, which is how r2 came to report it absent. A lane must replace the row argument's k-rational-point construction at closed points by something that survives a residue field strictly larger than k -- not weaken a binder.

items.title: Identity component and degree-zero points
items.summary:
Identity component and degree-zero points. Two sorries in Picard/IdentityComponent.lean:
finrank_eq_genus (:1896) and kPoints_iff_kerDegree (:1939). The degree map itself is BUILT
and sorry-free (PicScheme.degree :1702, pinned via ClassDegreePinned with a non-vacuity
test), the Pic^0 inclusion is BUILT, and the easy direction of the kernel characterisation
is landed (degree_eq_zero_of_class_eq_zero :1733); the open half is the converse.

THE DIMENSION HALF IS NOW REDUCED TO TWO NAMED INPUTS, NEITHER DIMENSION-THEORETIC
(run 0067 r7, Picard/GroupSchemeHomogeneity.lean, 11 declarations, 0 sorries, axiom-clean
with three firing controls):

Pic^0 is a GROUP scheme, so translations are automorphisms of the underlying scheme and the
embedding dimension is constant along a translate orbit. This kills the "uniform cotangent
bound" that three earlier rows (r5, r6) named as the <= half's open content -- it was never
a separate piece of mathematics here. Since the value at the identity is an EQUALITY, one
point serves both directions:

  topologicalKrullDim_eq_genus_of_homogeneous -- AXIOM-CLEAN, gives dim Pic^0 = g from
  (i) the cotangent value at the identity, (ii) regularity of that one stalk, (iii) the
  orbit condition.

  topologicalKrullDim_eq_genus_of_homogeneous_of_regular -- discharges (i) from front (a)
  verbatim, since genus C is DEFINED as the H^1 finrank (Genus.lean:41). Reports sorryAx,
  inherited from front (a) alone, with the clean sibling above it as the control.

*** RETRACTED (run 0067 r8, commit 27f526ea7): EVERYTHING ABOVE FROM "THE DIMENSION HALF IS NOW
REDUCED" IS WRONG. THE ORBIT CONDITION IS NOT A GAP -- IT IS CONTRADICTORY FOR g >= 1, so both
topologicalKrullDim_eq_genus_of_homogeneous theorems are VACUOUS exactly where the A.3 leg
exists, and the uniform cotangent bound the r7 row declared dead is REINSTATED as owed. ***

Picard/HomogeneityOrbitCollapse.lean proves topologicalKrullDim_eq_zero_of_homogeneous: the
orbit condition ALONE forces topologicalKrullDim Pic^0 = 0, hence genus_eq_zero_of_homogeneous
gives genus C = 0. No hypothesis on k. Three steps: a translation is an ISO of schemes hence a
homeomorphism; the identity point is CLOSED (a section of a morphism to Spec k is a closed
immersion with singleton range); a homeomorphism carries closed points to closed points. So
"every point is a translate of the identity" makes every point closed = T1, and a nonempty
SOBER T1 space has topologicalKrullDim 0.

FOURTH WRONG FRAMING of this leg; the r7 text above superseded the third. The tell was already
in this project: identityComponent_irreducibleSpace_of_isAlgClosed (IdentityComponent.lean:866)
translates through CLOSED points then needs JACOBSON DENSITY to sweep up the non-closed ones --
the step a rational orbit cannot supply. REUSABLE RULE: an orbit of rational points cannot
cover a scheme; use a COVER (AJCR's smoothOfRelativeDimension_of_translation_cover quantifies
over a ZeroHypercover), not an orbit of points.

WHAT IS ACTUALLY OWED: front (a); regularity at the identity (free over a perfect field via
isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_smooth_of_perfectField, a hypothesis so the statement stays over an
arbitrary field per I-0491); and the UNIFORM COTANGENT BOUND, needing a transport that reaches
NON-CLOSED points -- an extension-valued translation or a density argument. SURVIVES r7
untouched: the cotangent-invariance theorems (finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_of_ringEquiv,
finrank_cotangentSpace_stalk_eq_of_isIso), which concern a single isomorphism.

NOTE finrank_eq_genus HAS ZERO CONSUMERS and sits UPSTREAM of the dimension machinery in the
import graph (IdentityComponent imports only FGAPicRepresentability/GeometricallyConnectedSection/
DivDegree/Genus). Closing it in place would need an import inversion; the live statement of
the same mathematics is the Pic0Dimension/GroupSchemeHomogeneity pair. Do not price it as the
blocker.

SEARCH DATUM worth reusing: mathlib v4.31 has NO functoriality for IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace
-- no map along a ring homomorphism of any kind. Transport a cotangent dimension via
Submodule.spanFinrank (Ideal.spanRank_map_le both ways + antisymmetry, no Noetherian needed)
then Nakayama. AJC's own spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le_of_surjective is `private`.

RESULT 1 -- THE RESIDUE LOCUS, and this is the keepable content. Leaf B owes Module.rank of Omega on ONE affine CHART ALGEBRA per point, not on the away-localisations. Two docstrings here and my own published note I-1088 had it on the localisations; all corrected (I-1159). Nothing in either project computes a chart. No antecedent of leaf B is witnessed at any curve.

NOT A REDUCTION -- my own r3 claim, refuted and retracted (I-1179/I-1181, reproduced by me before propagating). smoothOfRelativeDimension_iff_pointwise_rank is mathlibs @[mk_iff] smoothOfRelativeDimension_iff composed with a per-algebra iff, applied pointwise. Mathlib ALSO already ships the Locally-free pointwise form HasRingHomProperty.iff_exists_appLE_locally with both side conditions as named lemmas. So the Locally wrapper was an artifact of MY LEMMA CHOICE (iff_appLE), not a discovery about the leaf, and mathlib discharges that quantifier. Same shape as the leafB_iff_appLE overclaim of r2. DO NOT re-publish a chart-level restatement as a reduction: grep the class for @[mk_iff] and search iff_exists_appLE* first.

RESULT 2 -- DESCENT SPLITS LEAF B UNEVENLY, and it reprices every k-bar/k^s-first plan. Bare Smooth DESCENDS along surjective+flat+quasicompact (mathlib instance; landed as smooth_of_pullback_snd), so smoothness proved over an extension returns to k free. The NUMERAL does not: it ASCENDS (smoothOfRelativeDimension_ascends_baseChange) and mathlib has no DescendsAlong for the graded class. Confirmed by an independent name-independent census.

AND THE BLOCKER IS ONE LEVEL LOWER THAN THE NUMERAL. Mathlibs codescent lemmas all delegate to an algebra-level of_P_tensorProduct_of_faithfullyFlat; there is NO such lemma for Algebra.IsStandardSmooth (scan empty against controls returning the seven that have one). So UNGRADED standard smoothness already fails to descend. Splitting the graded property as IsStandardSmooth AND rank does NOT reduce descent to the rank, because the rank half needs Module.Free Omega, which arrives only FROM standard smoothness. TWO mathlib-shaped bricks, neither Picard-specific.

Also true and unchanged from r2: obligation 4 IMPLIES obligation 2 (geometricallyReduced_of_leafB), so the headline five are not five distances. And Nontrivial of chart sections is FREE from the point (Scheme.component_nontrivial), not an obligation.

CAVEAT for consumers: the Pic0-specific leafB_iff_pointwise_rank is axiom-clean per-declaration but sorryAx-REACHABLE at any use site, because [HasPicSchemeEt C] has the unconditional instHasPicSchemeEt projecting the seam sorry. The GENERIC engine stays clean when applied -- state carryable work against that.

items.title: Smoothness, properness, and irreducibility
items.summary:
WHICH TOWER THIS ROW IS ABOUT -- added by review-ajc 2026-07-29, because everything below is
written about the side no curve inhabits, and a prover reading it would spend the round under an
uninhabited class.

Both line numbers cited below (Pic0AbelianVariety.lean:1135 geometricallyReduced, :1373
universallyClosed) carry [HasPicScheme C]. That class has ZERO instances: its only producer is the
conditional picSchemeOfHasRationalPoint, and hasRationalPoint_of_curve was deleted as FALSE
(protection I-0491). Kernel-measured census: 76 binder sites on [HasPicScheme C] vs 15 on
[HasPicSchemeEt C], no declaration binding both (I-0938). So discharging the two sorries below
proves something about no curve until a rational point is supplied.

THE HEADLINE'S COUNTERPARTS, which are the ones under picardJacobianWitness: Pic0Et.geometricallyReduced
(Picard/Pic0Et.lean:174) and Pic0Et.universallyClosed (:227), both carrying [HasPicSchemeEt C], which
IS unconditionally inhabited (instHasPicSchemeEt, a projection of the central sorry). They are two of
the five obligations named on AJC.jacobian.assembly.

THE MATHEMATICS BELOW IS NOT WASTED -- it TRANSFERS, and one half is free. MEASURED by review-ajc in a
scratch file, lake env lean EXIT=0, zero diagnostics (I-0944): the kbar reduction this row records is
NOT specific to Pic0Scheme. Its engine smooth_of_grpObj_of_isReduced_algebraicClosureBaseChange
(Picard/GroupSchemeSmoothAlgClosed.lean:156) binds an arbitrary group scheme, and Pic0Et proves both of
its binders unconditionally (locallyOfFiniteType :127, grpObj :104). So

  IsReduced (Pic0SchemeEt C x_k kbar)  =>  Smooth (Pic0SchemeEt C).hom   AND  GeometricallyReduced (...)

both elaborate in three lines, the second discharging the sorry at Pic0Et.lean:174. The two-for-one
collapse recorded below therefore holds on the headline tower too. TRAP: Pic0Et.lean's import cone
(FGAPicRepresentability + IdentityComponent) does NOT see the Smooth.geometricallyReduced instance --
add import AlgebraicJacobian.Curve.GeometricallyReduced or synthesis fails and you will wrongly
conclude the bridge is absent. Pic0AbelianVariety.lean:1209-1213 records that same lesson for its own
version; the trap re-fired one level up.

STILL OWED either way: IsReduced (Pic0Et x_k kbar) is the real mathematics (Kleiman s5 cor:sm,
Cartier) and is a hypothesis in both probes. ajc-p3 confirms no Cartier and no CharZero-reducedness
result exists under Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry, so this is genuine content and not a missing import.

THE PROPERNESS CAVEAT IS RETIRED -- it was MY hedge and ajc-p3 measured past it (I-1032, 2026-07-29).
This row said "the PROPERNESS half is NOT measured to transfer ... so do not assume it". It does
transfer: QuasiCompact is free from isFiniteTypeGeometricallyIrreducible.2.1, so
UniversallyClosed.of_valuativeCriterion applies on the etale side, and UniversallyClosed fpqc-descends
from kbar. Measured with imports rebuilt first (lake build EXIT=0, 8625 jobs; then lake env lean
EXIT=0), which matters here because this row already records the import trap that makes the bridge
look absent.

WITH THE NEGATIVE RESULT THAT BOUNDS IT, and it is the part a lane must not skip: IsProper itself has
NO DescendsAlong instance for (Surjective inf Flat inf QuasiCompact) at v4.31. Only the
UniversallyClosed conjunct descends. So "properness transfers" means the conjunct this row's sorry
actually names, not IsProper as a whole.

A lane taking this row should say which tower it is proving, and prefer the Et one.

--- ORIGINAL SUMMARY, mathematics unchanged and still correct on its own terms ---

Smoothness, properness, and irreducibility. TWO sorries in Picard/Pic0AbelianVariety.lean:
geometricallyReduced (:1135) and universallyClosed (:1373). Both are fully reduced -- the
structural assembly is discharged and each is now a single named geometric input. Geometric
irreducibility and the GrpObj structure are already THEOREMS, not obligations.

SMOOTHNESS: one hypothesis suffices, and it is a statement about a SINGLE scheme. IsReduced of
Pic^0 x_k Spec kbar gives smoothness (smooth_of_isReduced_algebraicClosureBaseChange, resting on
mathlib's smooth_of_grpObj which already contains BOTH the translation argument and the descent
along Spec kbar -> Spec k) AND it discharges geometricallyReduced itself
(geometricallyReduced_of_isReduced_algebraicClosureBaseChange, via Smooth.geometricallyReduced).
So the two apparently independent obligations collapse to one. Do not state a version quantified
over all field extensions: GeometricallyReduced has NO MorphismProperty.DescendsAlong instance in
mathlib v4.31 (checked here and independently by AJCR, I-0495), so the general->kbar reduction is
not available from mathlib -- but this project owns the converse through
Curve/GeometricallyReduced.lean, which is what makes the single-scheme form legitimate.
Mathematics owed: Kleiman section 5 cor:sm -- H^2(C,O_C) = 0 on a curve makes the deformation
functor of an invertible sheaf unobstructed. Characteristic-free BECAUSE dim C = 1 (Pic_{X/k} can
be non-smooth in char p for surfaces -- Igusa).

PROPERNESS HAS EXACTLY ONE LIVE ROUTE, and two are refuted:
 * LIVE: universallyClosed_of_valuativeCriterion. Needs ValuativeCriterion.Existence of
   (Pic0Scheme C).hom; the QuasiCompact side condition mathlib's criterion wants is already a
   theorem here. Through representability a Spec R-point IS a relative Picard class, so the
   lifting statement is the concrete assertion that an invertible sheaf on C x_k Spec K extends
   over the valuation ring -- the classical content of properness, and the same species as
   DualNumber.free_of_cyclic_mod_eps.
 * REFUTED, do not retry: the ambient route. Universal closedness of Pic_{C/k} is not merely hard,
   it is FALSE -- it forces CompactSpace on an infinite disjoint union over deg in Z
   (Picard/AmbientPicNotProper.lean, 5 declarations, axiom-clean). This does NOT affect the
   Pic^0 statement: Pic^0 is quasi-compact, Pic is not.
 * REFUTED on vocabulary: the quasi-projectivity route (Kleiman th:qpp&p). Mathlib v4.31 has no
   quasi-projectivity API at all, which is also why smoothProperQuotient is unprovable as stated
   (I-0074 Caveat 2 -- and do NOT reintroduce a global instance for it).

MEASURE AT A SYNTHESIS SITE. smooth/proper and all their reductions quantify over
[HasPicScheme C] and therefore report CLEAN axioms at the declaration while the caller's
synthesis supplies sorryAx. Every clean claim in this leg has been probed against controls that
DO fire sorryAx; keep that discipline or the completeness number is fiction.

     live route, universallyClosed_of_valuativeCriterion -- the ambient route is REFUTED

     over deg in Z; Picard/AmbientPicNotProper.lean), and the quasi-projectivity route needs
     vocabulary mathlib v4.31 does not have (I-0074 Caveat 2).

 (c) DEGREE / DIMENSION (AJC.pic0av.identity). Two sorries. The degree map is BUILT and
     sorry-free. THE DIMENSION HALF'S r7 REDUCTION IS REFUTED (run 0067 r8, 27f526ea7): its

     T1 hence topologicalKrullDim 0 (Picard/HomogeneityOrbitCollapse.lean), so both
     topologicalKrullDim_eq_genus_of_homogeneous theorems are VACUOUS where this leg exists.
     The "uniform cotangent bound" that r7 declared dead is REINSTATED as the owed statement,

* DivFamily.zero pi T -- the EMPTY DIVISOR, for ARBITRARY pi : X -> S and T : Over S. F = 0, q = 0, so ker q = O_{X_T} and the divisor condition holds because O/O = 0 cuts out D = empty. No hypothesis on pi: not proper, not smooth, not separated. THE FIRST INHABITANT: at the parent commit, 148 mentions of DivFamily in AJC and zero producers (audited independently; both numbers exactly confirmed).
* WHY IT IS NOT VACUOUS, measured not asserted: IsLocallyTrivial (0 : Y.Modules) is FALSE at every point (restrict-of-zero is zero, forcing subsingleton sections, contra Scheme.component_nontrivial). So kerLocallyTrivial at F = 0 asserts a rank-ONE statement and genuinely excludes the rival 'unit divisor' F = O, q = id.
* Base change: pullbackAlong_zero, so DivFunctor.map_zeroClass makes zeroClass a GLOBAL SECTION of Div, not a per-object choice. fiberDeg_zero / hasFiberDeg_zero give degree 0 everywhere, hence an inhabitant of (DivFunctorDeg pi 0).obj T.

THE DELIVERABLE: picEt_crossBaseIso (Picard/PicEtCrossBase.lean:679) --

It needs NO separability -- only [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom], [IsProper C.hom] and [Algebra k k']. p1's reason (PicEtCrossBase.lean:670-672) is that the identification is about pullback PROJECTIONS rather than about etale COVERS, so finite separability is a constraint of the GALOIS input that consumes this, not of the identification itself. Anyone pricing the Galois step must therefore NOT assume separability was already spent here.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO, from the file's own disclaimer (:674-678) which I checked and am not softening: it closes no sorry in FGAPicRepresentability.lean and witnesses no antecedent of fgaPicardRepresentability for any curve.

REPAIR SCOREBOARD after this landing -- FOUR inputs, two closed: (1) descent test, landed r2 (EtaleFieldCover.lean); (3) THIS, cross-base identification, landed; (2) semilinear Galois action + quotient, still gated on the instance-free HasGaloisQuotient; (4) the k^s section, which has no producer in AJC (I-1135) and is ajc-p3's port under AJC.picrep.sepclosed-section.

--- ORIGINAL SPECIFICATION BELOW (its "finite separable k'/k" is the clause corrected above) ---

CLOSED 2026-07-30 by ajc-p1 (run 0083 r3): Picard/PicEtCrossBase.lean, rooted at AlgebraicJacobian.lean, 700 lines, NO sorry, all ten declarations axiom-clean [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] under lake env lean against a control -- fgaPicardRepresentability still reports sorryAx in the same run. Commits 3f050878cc, ca4dc7a9b1, 38d60641ac, 33fe30e27a.

THE RESULT. picEt_crossBaseIso: for a smooth proper curve C over k and ANY field extension k-prime, picEt of the base-changed curve is isomorphic to picEt C restricted along Over.map -- as functors on (Sch/k-prime)^op. Group-valued form etaleSheaf_crossBaseIso.

THIS ROW ASKED FOR TOO MUCH, and the next reader should know: the row text and the seam docstring both state the obligation for FINITE SEPARABLE k-prime/k. NEITHER hypothesis is needed. The argument is about pullback PROJECTIONS, not about etale covers, so it holds for an arbitrary field extension. Finite-separability is a constraint of the GALOIS input (EtaleFieldCover.lean, input 1) and was double-counted onto this brick.

HOW IT DECOMPOSED, four layers, three of them nearly free. (1) Total-space cancellation: one mathlib lemma, pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso -- baseChangeField C k-prime IS by definition the pullback of C.hom along phi, so C_k-prime x_k-prime T and C x_k T are canonically isomorphic. (2) The H_T-coset relation transports both ways with the SAME coset witness N, because the two projections to T agree -- this is the layer where the two subgroups being quotiented by have to correspond, and it is the substantive one. (3) Hence a bijection per test, the round trips being the isos own hom_inv_id/inv_hom_id through relPicRel_of_iso; additive because addition is descended tensor. (4) Naturality in T -- and THIS was the surprise: it is not a fact about curves at all. Stated for an ARBITRARY category with pullbacks (pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_naturality) it falls to pullback.hom_ext from the isos two projection identities, and the project-spelling square is that lemma applied, since baseChangeOverC IS the generic pullback.map.

THE SHEAFIFICATION LAYER IS FREE, which is the finding that prices the row: picEt is a CATEGORICAL sheafification, and mathlibs Functor.pushforwardContinuousSheafificationCompatibility says sheafification commutes with restriction along a continuous functor. Restriction along Over.map is continuous for the two localised etale topologies by pure synthesis. CONTROL, so this is not a stale-import artifact: the strictly stronger IsDenseSubsite at the SAME two topologies does NOT synthesize, so the induced pushforward is not an equivalence and the compatibility iso is not vacuous.

AJCR WAS CORRECTLY CALLED NOT-PORTABLE by review-ajc (I-1076). Its picEtCrossBaseEquiv is 468 lines mostly spent on a section-ring scalar tower, which a sheafification-based picEt does not need -- exactly because of the mathlib lemma above. The lead was worth more than the transcription.

It closes one INPUT of the routes repair. Per review-ajc I-1135 the repair has FOUR inputs, not three: below all of them sits a section over separably closed fields with no producer in AJC (now held by ajc-p3/ajc-p4 as sepclosed rows).

items.summary:
ADVANCED 2026-07-30 by ajc-p1 (run 0083 r7), owner ajc-p1. The MORPHISM-LEVEL COHERENCE residue that ajc-p2 left on this row is CLOSED, and it was mispriced in both directions. Seam sorry untouched; no antecedent of fgaPicardRepresentability witnessed for any curve.

LANDED, DO NOT REDO. Picard/GaloisDescent/PicEtGaloisBridge.lean, rooted at AlgebraicJacobian.lean, 8 declarations, ZERO code sorries, lake build EXIT=0 with zero warnings from the file.
 * twistTest -- the gamma-twist of the base-changed test T_k', as an endomorphism IN THE SLICE OVER Spec k. The object a gamma-invariance hypothesis is ABOUT, and it did not exist: GaloisDescent/ twisted modules, algebras and Spec of a ring, never a base-changed test.
 * coverSelfSection -- the gamma-component section T_k' -> T_k' x_T T_k', <id, twist gamma>, with the two projection identities as simp lemmas. THIS IS THE COHERENCE the previous residue named.
 * invariant_of_projections_agree -- projection agreement IMPLIES gamma-invariance for every gamma, UNCONDITIONALLY: arbitrary field k, only [Algebra k k'], no Module.Finite, no IsSeparable, no IsGalois, arbitrary test.
 * projections_agree_of_invariant -- the converse, as an implication with ONE antecedent explicit and UNDISCHARGED (hcov: the Gal-indexed sections generate a COVERING sieve).
 * exists_unique_descend_picEt_of_invariant -- ajc-p2's exists-unique with its hypothesis replaced by gamma-invariance, which is what G1 actually holds.

THE REPRICING, and it is the finding. ajc-p2's SS4 named the residue as the morphism-level coherence and listed its ingredients as pullbackSpecIso, IsIso (sigmaSpec ...) and galoisSelfTensorEquiv. NONE OF THE THREE IS NEEDED. The coherence is pullback.lift_fst and pullback.lift_snd -- the section exists by the universal property from twistTest_comp_coverMap alone. What the splitting is needed for is something the residue did not name.

AND THE TWO DIRECTIONS ARE NOT SYMMETRIC, which is why this row is advanced and not closed. Agreement => invariance is functoriality along one section, hence free at full generality. The converse CANNOT be functoriality: the two projections are not in the image of any single section, so it needs the gamma-sections to JOINTLY cover the self-pullback. That is a covering statement, a different kind of fact, and it is where IsGalois enters -- by ajc-p1's galoisSelfTensorHom_bijective_iff_isGalois the splitting is FALSE below the Galois level, so there hcov fails rather than being unproved.

hcov NON-VACUITY, by degenerate substitution per I-1413 rather than asserted: at k' = k the group is trivial, coverMap is an iso, the single section is an iso and generates top, which is covering. So the implication is not conditioned on a false statement. hcov at a NONTRIVIAL Galois level is what remains owed, and it is the whole of what remains on this row.

WHAT THIS DOES NOT DO: k'-side representability untouched, G2's scheme-level quotient untouched. It changes WHICH hypothesis a G1 consumer must supply.

CORRECTION I OWE, on my own r6 claim: I told ajc-p2 that "your Galois binder is forced" on the invariance step and they refuted it from binder lists. They were right about the DESCENT and I am now right about the BRIDGE for a reason neither of us gave: sections 3 and 4 of this file both carry NO IsGalois binder, because the Galois hypothesis is not in either implication -- it is in the ANTECEDENT hcov, which is a hypothesis rather than a binder. So "Galois enters exactly once, at the bridge" is correct, and it enters as a covering property, not as an instance.

RESIDUE LOCATED, and attempted rather than only named. hcov_iff_scheme_level: membership in the slice topology IS membership of the transported sieve on the underlying scheme (GrothendieckTopology.mem_over_iff, free). So hcov is not about the slice, the test T, or picEt -- it is that the Gal-indexed family of SCHEME morphisms (coverSelfSection T gamma).left etale-covers the self-pullback. I tried to close it at a nontrivial Galois level and did NOT: infer_instance for IsOpenImmersion (coverSelfSection T gamma).left FAILS there, with the sorryAx control live in the same probe so it is not a stale-import artefact. The covering property is therefore not free from the etale-precoverage machinery, and a lane closing this row must build it. That is what remains, and it is the whole of what remains.

THREE AUDIT FINDINGS AGAINST THIS ROW'S OWN OUTPUT, all reproduced by me and fixed in-tree (commit b85ecf497a). Inherit the corrected forms, not the paragraphs above them.
 * I-1454, the serious one: MY hcov NON-VACUITY WITNESS SITS WHERE THE CONSEQUENT IS FREE. At Mono (specMapAlgebra k k') cancel_mono forces EVERY gamma to the identity, so the twist is the identity, hinv is free, and the two projections COINCIDE -- projections_agree_of_invariant's conclusion holds there with NEITHER hypothesis. Landed as theorems specGal_eq_id_of_mono and twistTest_eq_id_of_mono. So hcov is SATISFIABLE and no exhibited model separates the two projections. THE RULE, one turn past I-1413: landing the witness as a declaration audits the ANTECEDENT; content is a question about the CONSEQUENT at the witness site.
 * I-1455: twistLeft and specGal ALREADY EXISTED -- rfl-equal to pullbackGalMap and toSpecAut in Picard/FiniteGaloisQuotient.lean, which also ships the two projection identities and the full semilinear action. My absence claim censused the DIRECTORY Picard/GaloisDescent/ and published it as a project fact; the declaration was one directory up. What is genuinely this row's is the slice packaging and the section-2-onward content.
 * I-1458 (ajc-p2): "closing this row means building it" OVER-PRICES hcov. The topology half is ONE LINE (zariskiTopology_le_etaleTopology of a Cover). Only the open-immersion half is owed, and even there a failed inferInstance is not absence: IsOpenImmersion (Sigma.iota ...) is a THEOREM whose instance search also fails, at the very object selfTensorSpecCoproduct produces.

SO THE RESIDUE, corrected twice and now stated once: the MIDDLE step only -- base change of selfTensorSpecCoproduct along T_k' -> Spec k', then matching the coproduct's gamma-component to coverSelfSection T gamma. Not the topology, not a from-scratch covering argument. And the right FIRST target is strictly weaker than hcov: mere projection INEQUALITY at any extension with a nontrivial automorphism, which would give this row the non-degenerate model it still lacks.

items.title: DECIDED: etale-sheafify — no rational-point binder on the headline
items.summary:
DECIDED BY THE HUMAN 2026-07-28: BRANCH (2), ETALE-SHEAFIFY. This node is no longer a decision; it is execution work. Binding form: protection I-0491. Full reasoning: I-0372 (human comment, same date).

THE CLAIM THE PROJECT NOW MAKES: the Jacobian headline is stated over an ARBITRARY base field with NO rational-point binder, exactly as Challenge.lean declares it. The relative Picard functor is ETALE-sheafified and that is what gets represented — Kleimans own formulation, full challenge strength.

WHY, and it is a specification argument. Challenge.lean binds Jacobian C with no rational point, and binds a point explicitly only where Abel-Jacobi needs one (ofCurve (P : 1 -> C)). A headline carrying [HasRationalPoint C] therefore answers a different question than the one posed. Moreover hasRationalPoint_of_curve is FALSE rather than unproved, so everything under the general-field witness rested on an inconsistent hypothesis. The build-cost asymmetry between branches, reported honestly by ajc-truth over four sessions, was explicitly NOT the deciding factor.

THE FOUR EXECUTION CLAUSES (protection I-0491 carries the binding text):
 1. DELETE hasRationalPoint_of_curve. Never prove it; no new consumer.
 2. Restate the representability obligation for the etale-sheafified functor, without [HasRationalPoint C]. One named sorry, docstring saying it is expected to stay open.
 3. Port from the sibling Rebuild project, which already has the functor SORRY-FREE: Picard/PicEtAff.lean (394 lines), Picard/Pic0Functor.lean (182), Picard/RelPicCoverInjective.lean (89), re-verified zero sorries 2026-07-28. AJC is the outlier, not the standard.
 4. KEEP picardJacobianWitnessOfHasRationalPoint as an explicitly labelled CONDITIONAL milestone and picardJacobianWitnessOfIsAlgClosed as a genuine k-bar theorem. Neither is the headline, anywhere.

DOCUMENTS TO RE-AIM: blueprint FGA chapter (sec:fga_pic_setup should name the etale formulation as the one realised; lem:curve_hypothesis_gap and rem:rational_point_scope now record a decision rather than an open branch), README.md, TO_USER.md.

ORTHOGONAL AND UNCHANGED: the Milne-Kollar route stays committed, Quot stays retained-not-revived. Both routes carried the rational point identically, so the route choice never depended on this. Over k-bar the point remains a THEOREM (hasRationalPoint_of_curve_of_isAlgClosed, axiom-clean) and that lane is untouched.

items.title: Pullback-tensor and fibre base change
items.summary:
AUDITED 2026-07-30 (review-ajc r4). This row bundles TWO deliverables; the first is LANDED and sorry-free, the second is genuinely OPEN. The row read as wholly unstarted since its creation on 2026-07-23 and was never re-measured, so a lane pricing it would have re-proved the landed half.

CLAUSE 1 -- DONE, DO NOT RE-PROVE. 'The canonical pullback tensor comparison is an isomorphism' IS proved: Scheme.Modules.pullbackTensorIsoOfLocallyTrivial (Picard/TensorObjSubstrate/PullbackTensorIso.lean:153), for line bundles via the chart-chase plus isIso_of_isIso_restrict. Zero body sorries in that file (comments stripped). It has a one-sided companion pullbackTensorIsoOfRightLocallyTrivial and the IsIso form pullbackTensorMap_isIso_of_right_locallyTrivial (PullbackTensorOneSided.lean:275, :264). Already CONSUMED at 8+ sites in Picard/RelPicFunctor.lean (:366, :389, :433, :468, :609, :792, :819) and cited by QuotFunctorDef.lean:448 -- so this is settled substrate, not a frontier.

CLAUSE 2 -- OPEN, and the file that would host it says so in the subjunctive. 'The quasi-coherent tensor-section input used by Hilbert-function base change' is NOT landed. Picard/TensorSectionFormula.lean:145-155 states that the affine tensor-section formula 'WOULD give, for A B quasi-coherent and V affine, the fact that the section restriction Gamma(A tensor B, V) -> Gamma(A tensor B, D(f)) is IsLocalizedModule (powers f)' -- and then supplies only the CONVERSE packaging (isQuasicoherent_of_isLocalizedModule_basicOpen, :185), explicitly described as 'exactly the criterion the 01CB (tensorObj/sheafTensorObj) instance feeds ONCE THE AFFINE SECTION-LOCALIZATION IS IN HAND'. That antecedent is absent.

MEASURED ABSENT, with the project filter (a bare horizon search returns SubProjects hits under identical names -- I-1124): tensorSectionHom_isIso, isIso_tensorSectionHom, tensorSection_localization, affine_tensorSection all return no exact-name match under --lib Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge. No instance of IsQuasicoherent for tensorObj exists anywhere in AlgebraicJacobian/. What DOES exist in that file is the substrate: tensorSectionHom (:101), its naturality (:115), the top-level identification (:123), and the categorical crux isIso_sheafification_tensorSectionUnit (:137).

SO THE OPEN OBLIGATION, named: the affine tensor-section formula -- for A B quasi-coherent and V affine, Gamma(A,V) tensor_{Gamma(X,V)} Gamma(B,V) -> Gamma(A tensor B, V) is an isomorphism (equivalently the basic-open localization form). Its heart is RingTheory.Localization.BaseChange ((M tensor_R N)_f = M_f tensor_{R_f} N_f), per the file's own note. Discharging it feeds isQuasicoherent_of_isLocalizedModule_basicOpen and yields the 01CB instance.

NOT ON THE CRITICAL PATH to the seam. The Hilbert-function base-change consumers are all sorry-free already (GradedHilbertSerre, HilbertPolynomial, QuotFlatBaseChange, QuotSupportBaseChange, RigidPushforward{Chart,Gamma}BaseChange, SectionBaseChange -- 0 body sorries each), and no .lean file flags the tensor comparison as open. Nothing consumes this row as blocking. Left pending deliberately: it is real but off the representability critical path, so it is not a round target.
